title: A parity obstruction to extending single-sector Fock weights in correlated worldline optomechanics
description: A theoretical note on a full quadratic optomechanical pulse and the large-replica Fock endpoint weights used in correlated worldline theory. It derives the different vacuum subsequence limits, compares the single-sector operation with a product over sectors, and distinguishes formal endpoint ratios from detector probabilities. Includes editable source and reproducible arithmetic checks.
